info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Retail Orders API allows businesses to manage their order fulfillment processes by canceling retail orders that are no longer required. This endpoint can be utilized by retail operations personnel or e-commerce platforms looking to streamline order management workflow. It ensures efficient handling of existing orders while maintaining accurate inventory and customer satisfaction. Businesses can integrate this API to automate cancellation requests and improve operational efficiency.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an order that has been previously placed. Ensure that the order is eligible for cancellation as per the business rules.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for canceling an order. Ensure that you provide the necessary identifiers and information to successfully process the cancellation.

200.description: The order cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling an order.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Order Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancel operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique identifier for the order reference.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the cancel operation.

state.description: The current state of the order after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation result.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.description: The response returned after successfully canceling an order.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Information about the audit trail of the order cancellation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
